abstract: Evaluates pipeline contact inspection payloads, cathodic anomaly logging instruments, and transit propulsion requirements
system_message:
You are the Subsea structural engineering lead (STRUCT). Your responsibilities include evaluating pipeline contact inspection payloads, cathodic anomaly logging instruments, transit propulsion requirements, and ultrasonic thickness measurement capabilities for candidate subsea localization spreads.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Ultrasonic thickness measurement（PROBE）
information_points.content:
STRUCT-PROBE-8B1：For the Hybrid Crawler-Glider Spread, non-destructive testing bench sheets indicate an ultrasonic wall thickness resolution of 0.5 mm for the thickness logging head.
STRUCT-PROBE-9EH：For the Tethered Heavy ROV Spread, bench testing of the caliper and ultrasonic thickness logging head demonstrates an ultrasonic wall thickness resolution of 0.1 mm.
STRUCT-PROBE-TUP：For the Autonomous AUV Sonar Spread, the caliper and ultrasonic thickness logging head delivers an ultrasonic wall thickness resolution of 0.2 mm.

information_points.title: Evaluates pipeline contact inspection payloads, cathodic anomaly logging instruments, and transit propulsion requirements（INSPECT）
information_points.content:
STRUCT-INSPECT-TQP：For the Hybrid Crawler-Glider Spread, tooling integration records confirm that a cathodic potential profiling sensor is not integrated on the auxiliary sensor bus, while baseline transit fuel consumption for steaming to the anomaly site is 30 MT.
STRUCT-INSPECT-BB5：For the Tethered Heavy ROV Spread, the subsea vehicle auxiliary sensor bus features an integrated cathodic potential profiling sensor based on tooling integration sign-off of its silver/silver-chloride reference electrode, with a baseline transit fuel consumption to the offshore target sector rated at 30 MT.
STRUCT-INSPECT-C47：For the Autonomous AUV Sonar Spread, the subsea vehicle auxiliary sensor bus has a cathodic potential profiling sensor integrated (verified with a mounted and calibrated silver/silver-chloride reference electrode), and the nominal baseline transit fuel consumption from the Port of Aberdeen to the offshore pipeline target sector is 24 MT.
